Thanks — quick technical check from my side before the MAP is finalized:
- Current baseline: CloudWave shows an average of 1.8M tokens/day in Q3 and peak 3.1M tokens/day; typical sequence length 220-450 tokens.
- For 2.5x commit we should plan for GPU types G9x with mixed int8 quantization; this gives the best cost/latency profile for your workload.
- KV-cache warmup: recommend keeping a 30% prefix cache hit strategy for customer-facing prompts to preserve latency SLOs.
- Migration window: late Oct gives us time to pre-stage models and run perf tests.

Open questions for CloudWave:
1) Are you planning a new feature launch in Nov with a higher 99th latency sensitivity?
2) Do you expect more multi-region routing (US/EU) or mainly US?

If procurement needs an infra appendix I can attach a short perf runbook.

—Ben
